camel_example: aliyun ossutil api list-live-channel --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou --max-keys 100 --marker 'channel-1' --prefix 'fun/'
name: ListLiveChannel

parameters.help_en: Specifies that results are returned starting from the first LiveChannel alphabetically after the marker value
parameters.help_zh: 设定结果从marker之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of LiveChannels to return. The value of max-keys cannot exceed 1000.
Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
限定此次返回LiveChannel的最大数。max-keys取值不能大于1000。
默认值：100
parameters.name: max_keys

parameters.help_en: Specifies that only LiveChannels whose names contain the specified prefix are returned. When you use prefix for a query, the returned keys still contain the prefix
parameters.help_zh: 限定返回的LiveChannel必须以prefix作为前缀。注意使用prefix查询时，返回的key中仍会包含prefix
parameters.name: prefix
